subject.title: feat(agent): preserve interrupted-turn context and anchor session recall on search hits

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the hidden openclaw:turn-aborted transcript record and pagination-less anchored chat.history mode together as permanent core contracts?
rationale: The implementation and proof are convincing, but both durable session state and a public Gateway response mode require explicit owner intent; the contributor's report of approval is not itself a visible owner decision in the supplied discussion.

options.title: Approve both contracts
options.body: Accept the combined additive design, require the public documentation and refreshed checks, then proceed toward merge.

options.title: Split contract review
options.body: Separate interruption persistence from anchored history so the durable-state and Gateway contracts can be accepted independently.

options.title: Defer the contracts
options.body: Retain current transcript and offset-only history behavior until maintainers select another recovery or cursor design.

recommendation.title: Approve both contracts
recommendation.body: Accept the combined additive design, require the public documentation and refreshed checks, then proceed toward merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The anchored response directly extends the native chat.history contract introduced in their adjacent merged work.
